comment: The connector caller token wire (ADR-0168 decision 7, extended by ADR 0178). The worker mints one per sandbox boot (apps/worker/src/curie_worker/caller_token.py) and the runner presents it to each hosted connector in the X-Curie-Caller header. A verifier holds only the public half, so what it checks must be exactly what the worker signs, and this file freezes that. The token is `cct.<payload>.<signature>`: payload is the base64url, unpadded, of the compact JSON object {agent, exp} with optional {run, work_item} (both or neither), sorted keys and ASCII escapes; signature is the base64url, unpadded, of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the ASCII bytes of `cct.<payload>`. `agent` is the stored agent name, verbatim. `exp` is absolute unix seconds. `run` and `work_item` are lowercase hyphenated UUIDs. Each vector carries `seed` (standard base64 of the 32-byte Ed25519 seed the chart's Secret holds), `public` (standard base64 of its 32-byte public key), the claims, and `minted`. Ed25519 signing is deterministic, so a minter must reproduce `minted` byte for byte. Read by apps/worker/tests/test_connector_caller_token.py, which rejects an unknown key so a key added for one reader cannot pass vacuously.

vectors.name: a_plain_agent_name
vectors.why: The common case: a deploy.yaml-shaped agent name and a far expiry.

vectors.name: the_same_claims_under_another_seed
vectors.why: The payload is identical and only the signature moves, so a verifier that checked the payload and skipped the signature would accept both.

vectors.name: a_stored_name_outside_the_bundle_shape_is_carried_verbatim
vectors.why: The API stores agent names wider than deploy.yaml accepts. The claim carries the stored name as it is, and the JSON escapes pin one encoding of it.

vectors.name: a_work_item_run
vectors.why: ADR 0178: run and work_item ride with agent and exp. A verifier that skipped run would not see this payload differ from the next vector.

vectors.name: the_same_work_item_under_another_run
vectors.why: The payload differs from a_work_item_run only in run, so a verifier that ignored the new claim would accept both.
